title: Recipe repo status page
lead: An admin page that shows whether the recipe repo is in sync or needs attention (ADR 0012).
boundary: **Not in this slice:** resolving a conflict in the browser (the admin fixes the clone on the host); pulling or pushing from the page; editing recipes.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: ADR 0012 says repo conflicts "are surfaced in the admin view". S11 stores a status and builds no UI, and no other slice shows it. A diverged remote stops recipe sync and then the plan, so an admin needs to see it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/larder/web/repo_views.py` (route `GET /admin/recipe-repo` on the `admin` blueprint from `auth_views`)
- `src/larder/web/templates/admin/recipe_repo.html`
- `src/larder/web/templates/base.html` (an "Recipe repo" link in the admin nav)
- `src/larder/web/__init__.py` (import `repo_views` before `auth_views.init_app`)
- `tests/test_repo_status_web.py`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `tests/test_repo_status_web.py`, built on `WebShellTestCase`; `larder.recipes.repo.status` is patched to return S11's `RepoStatus`:
1. `test_admin_sees_in_sync`
2. `test_admin_sees_needs_attention_with_detail_and_conflicted_files`
3. `test_admin_sees_not_cloned_yet`
4. `test_member_gets_403`
5. `test_unpaired_device_gets_401`
6. `test_detail_text_is_html_escaped`
7. `test_page_has_no_form_and_never_shows_the_repo_url` (read-only; `recipe_repo_url` may carry credentials)

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. A blueprint cannot gain routes after it is registered, and the 403 check in `auth_views._guard` is `request.blueprint == admin.name`. So `repo_views` defines `@auth_views.admin.get("/recipe-repo")`, and `create_app` imports it next to `auth_views`, before `auth_views.init_app`.
2. The view calls `repo.status(settings)` and renders: state (In sync, Needs attention, Not cloned yet), last sync time (the `when` filter), ahead and behind counts, conflicted files, and one line saying to fix the clone in the recipes directory on the host. The next sync clears it.
3. Add the nav link to the admin `<nav>` in `base.html`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - Web tests pass; with a deliberately diverged local bare remote, the dev server shows "Needs attention" and the conflicting file.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Add the recipe repo status page (S66).
